Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard (Reaffirmed 1997) 

SPECIFICATION FOR CERVICAL HALTER 



1. Scope -Specifies requirements for cervical halter. 

2. Shape and Dimensions -A typical cervical halter is shown in Fig. 1. 
:^ i. Material 

3.1 The fabric shall be plain woven and made of cotton or rayon or a blend of cotton and rayon. 

3.2 Filling Material- Filling material shall conform to IS : 7933-1975 'Specification for flexible 
polyurethane foam for domestic mattresses', and shall not be less than 18 mm thick. 

3.3 Rope -Polypropylene rope shall be used for holding the pads of the cervical halter in position. 

3.4 Sewing Thread — Cotton sewing thread of 60s/6( 100 d tax X 6) conforming to Variety No. 3 1 oi 
IS : 1720-1 978 'Specification for cotton sewing threads (second revision )'.

IS: 12173-1987 

4. Requirements 

4.1 The fabric shall be reasonably free from spinning, weaving and processing defects. It may be 
dyeo to the colour as agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 

4.2 The cervical, halter shall be tailored neatly. The reinforcement strip shall be neatly cut to the 
required size and arranged to form a uniform thickness throughout without any wrinkles or 
distortions. 

4.3 The cervical halter shall have a very soft feel when worn, to ensure maximum comfort and 
should be non-irritant. 

5. Marking 

5.1 The cervical halter shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 
5.1.1 Standard Marking- Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

6. Packaging -As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The cervical halter is made in one size only and is suitable for any patient, adult or child. The soft 
support pads are easily placed in position and hold the cord away from neck.
